bind_address.description: IP address the DICOD service listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

bind_port.description: TCP port the DICOD service listens on.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

storage_path.description: Filesystem path where DICOD stores its data and metadata.

compact_enabled.description: Whether to enable automatic background compaction of old data to reclaim space.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

log_file.description: Path to the DICOD log file.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads to process incoming requests.

worker_queue_size.description: Maximum size of the per-worker job queue.

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client IP ranges (CIDR) or hostnames. Connections from other sources will be rejected.

items.description: An allowed client address, either an IPv4/IPv6 CIDR block (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24') or a hostname.

tls_enabled.description: Whether to enable TLS encryption for client connections.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

rate_limits.description: List of per-IP rate limits (optional). Leave empty to disable rate limiting.

ip.description: IP address or CIDR block to apply the rate limit to.

requests_per_minute.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute from this IP.

metrics_enabled.description: Whether to expose an internal metrics endpoint.

metrics_port.description: Port for the metrics endpoint (only active if metrics are enabled).
